Coy Koi

Rules:

• The 7x7 grid is broken into 9 overlapping 3x3 boxes with dashed boundary lines cutting through the borders of the boxes.

• Digits along the vertical and horizontal boundary lines are included in each of the the adjacent boxes along the boundary line.

• Place the digits 1-9 exactly once into every 3x3 box.

• Digits do not repeat along rows and columns.

• Consecutive digits along the orange Dutch whispers line differ by at least 4.

• Digits separated by a white dot are consecutive. Digits separated by a black dot are in a 1:2 ratio (not all dots are given).
